realloc_log_no_fmt.note: Reallocate logged its size through msg! with a format argument, which runs core::fmt into a heap String on SBF; the same text is now built from decimal digits in a stack buffer and passed to sol_log. The log text is built to be byte-identical (not checked by the harness, which compares results and account state; those are unchanged).

write_single_borrow.note: Write took three RefCell borrows of the record (borrow for the header checks, borrow for the length, borrow_mut for the copy); it now takes one borrow_mut and bounds the copy with get_mut. Same checks in the same order, same errors.
